original_query: What is the media with the most sway on a buyer's consideration list?

confirmed.answer_text: TV ads have the strongest influence at 70%.; Reviews on vehicle review sites have the second-highest influence at 80%.; Search engine results/ads have 55% influence.; Information on auto manufacturer websites has 78% influence.
confirmed.summary: The infographic ranks the influence of different media sources on buyers' decisions to add a vehicle to their consideration list, with TV ads having the highest influence at 70%.
key_facts: TV ads have the strongest influence at 70%.
Reviews on vehicle review sites have the second-highest influence at 80%.
Information on auto manufacturer websites has 78% influence.
